2607.02782.title: A Preliminary Study on Explaining Risk of Code Changes using LLM-Based Prediction Models
2607.02782.paper_summary: Predictions by machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) models are often received skeptically unless they are paired with intelligible explanations. In the context of just-in-time defect prediction, highlighting small portions of a software change (diff) -- beyond rule-based lints -- where risk may be concentrated has not yet been extensively investigated. In this work, we leverage attention weights from an LLM-based Diff Risk Score (DRS) model to highlight parts of a diff that the model focuses on when predicting risk. We aggregate token-level attention into interpretable code units (lines, hunks, and files), and present the top-K units to developers as a lightweight form of guidance during code review. We evaluate our approach using expert-labeled changes that have caused real outages. Results show that the highlighted snippets cover expert-labeled outage-causing change lines 53.85% of the time when highlighting the top-2 hunks, while requiring developers to review 26.28% of the changed lines on average. Because attention is produced during standard model inference, the approach is scalable for large development workflows and can be surfaced in the code review UI with low additional latency.
2607.02782.paper_summary_zh: 機器學習 (ML) 和人工智慧 (AI) 模型的預測通常會受到懷疑，除非它們伴隨著可理解的解釋。<lb/>在即時缺陷預測的背景下，強調軟體變更 (diff) 的小部分——超越基於規則的檢查——其中風險可能集中，尚未被廣泛研究。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們利用基於 LLM 的差異風險分數 (DRS) 模型的注意力權重，來突出模型在預測風險時所關注的 diff 部分。<lb/>我們將標記級別的注意力聚合成可解釋的程式碼單位（行、塊和檔案），並將前 K 名單位呈現給開發者，作為代碼審查過程中的輕量級指導形式。<lb/>我們使用專家標記的變更進行評估，這些變更導致了實際的故障。<lb/>結果顯示，在突出前 2 個塊時，所標示的片段覆蓋了專家標記的導致故障的變更行的 53.85%，同時要求開發者平均審查 26.28% 的變更行。<lb/>由於注意力是在標準模型推斷過程中產生的，因此該方法對於大型開發工作流程具有可擴展性，並且可以在代碼審查 UI 中以低延遲顯示。
